description: Reference v1 cache behavior. T007 (R006) verifies that with FORGE_TOKEN_OPT=0, hooks/tool-cache.js + hooks/tool-cache-store.js produce these characteristics. This fixture documents the parity contract; tests/tool-cache-kill-switch.test.cjs asserts each invariant directly rather than doing a byte-for-byte JSON comparison (the cache entry is allowed to carry a forward-compat `class: 'volatile'` field, see note below).

forward_compat_notes.class_field: Cache entries written under FORGE_TOKEN_OPT=0 by post-T004 code may include `class: 'volatile'` for forward compat; the test treats this as parity-equivalent to no-class v1 entries because the read-side TTL resolves to flat 120s either way (entry.class || 'volatile' -> 120s).

guard_audit.hooks/tool-cache.js: process.env.FORGE_TOKEN_OPT === '0' gates: (a) isCacheableCommand 2-pattern path, (b) classifyPattern bypass (forces volatile), (c) Read mtime-keying skip, (d) Bash head-pinned key resolution skip, (e) flat 120s TTL on lookup
guard_audit.hooks/tool-cache-store.js: recordCacheEvent returns {written:false,disabled:true} early; classifyPattern + Read mtime-keying + head_pinned key suffix all gated by !=='0'
